interactions.mechanism: C1 checks extra_member against frozen 144 population. Any round-61 control receipts committed by C2 trigger extra_member.
interactions.amendment: Scope C1 extra_member check to round-<N> where N < 61.

interactions.mechanism: C2 adds capability row on demonstrated run. C1 checks scores_held == 3 (10/10/2). Capability text must not disrupt score table regex.
interactions.amendment: Explicitly declare C1 scores_held parser bounds to ignore non-score table edits.

interactions.mechanism: Both C1 (receipt_lineage, lineage_cases) and C2 (response_snapshot, header_audit) add rows to the gate registry table.
interactions.amendment: Coordinate table row appends in SKILL.md.

interactions.mechanism: C2 appends rows S430-S433. C3 modifies recheck cells for S001-S010 in place. C3 Condition C6 tests byte-identity of non-due rows against base.
interactions.amendment: Specify Condition C6 allows appended rows beyond base registry length.

interactions.mechanism: C3 rechecks S010 (RFC 9110). C2 opens S433 (RFC 9110). Both share underlying URL www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html, bumping W04 from 15 to 16.
interactions.amendment: Acknowledge W04 census count delta from S433/S010 URL sharing.

interactions.mechanism: All 3 claims write to round-61 lesson. C3 Condition C3 and C5 strictly parse lesson Gate lines. Syntax/merge errors in C1/C2 sections can fail C3.
interactions.amendment: Define distinct markdown sections for C1 mistakes, C2 Gate lines, and C3 Gate lines.

interactions.mechanism: Counters evaluate the unified revision <rev>. A failure in any one claim prevents a clean after-state revision.
interactions.amendment: Clarify build/falsify stage sequencing and atomic revision gating.

interactions.mechanism: Capture receipts feed C2 counter R3 and round report, but are not in controls/ and therefore not monitored by C1 lineage tool.
interactions.amendment: Document capture receipts as immutable input data; require sha256 pinning in manifest.
